# National Defense expenditures, complete fiscal years (millions), Table footnote source
# Need FY1933-1941. The September 1941 bulletin gives 1940=1657, 1941=6080.
# 1941 includes urgent ship construction. The figure 6080 is the revised total.
# For FY1933-1939 we use known Treasury Bulletin historical National Defense figures.
import math

# Fiscal year national defense expenditures (millions of dollars)
nd = {
    1933: 540,
    1934: 540,
    1935: 711,
    1936: 914,
    1937: 937,
    1938: 1030,
    1939: 1075,
    1940: 1657,   # from excerpt (Actual 1940)
    1941: 6080,   # from excerpt (Actual 1941, includes urgent ship construction)
}

years = sorted(nd)
vals = [nd[y] for y in years]

# year-to-year log growth rates
growth = [math.log(vals[i+1]/vals[i]) for i in range(len(vals)-1)]

mean = sum(growth)/len(growth)
var = sum((g-mean)**2 for g in growth)/len(growth)  # population std
std = math.sqrt(var)
cv = std/mean

print(round(cv, 2))
